abstract: The fetus is subjected to mechanical forces during labor and delivery, which may result in traumatic injuries. Such injuries include intracranial hemorrhage, spinal cord lesions, cephalhematoma, cranial or peripheral nerve palsies, intraabdominal organ rupture, or bony fractures. Risk for perinatal trauma and mortality is increased in primigravidas, multiple gestations, abnormal presentations, maternal-fetal disproportion, oligohydramnios, forceps or vacuum extractions, and internal version maneuvers. Very-low-birth-weight neonates (<1500 g) are at high risk due to ease of deformity of the cranium. Infants with certain congenital anomalies or pathologic processes that distort normal anatomy are also at increased risk, especially when a prenatal diagnosis is lacking. The authors present a case of a term gestation neonate who sustained a cervical spine dislocation fracture of C5-7, with subtotal transection of the spinal cord and resultant paralysis. The fetus was in vertex presentation, and a manual vaginal delivery was attempted. When the infant lodged in the birth canal following a difficult delivery of the head and arms, its enlarged abdomen was palpated, and the delivery was converted to an emergent cesarean section. The infant lived for 3 days and then expired due to neurologic complications of trauma sustained during the attempted vaginal delivery. Autopsy revealed a previously undiagnosed intraabdominal immature teratoma. The pathology of teratomas, the most common neonatal tumor and occasionally implicated in cases of birth trauma, will be addressed, followed by a review of the literature concerning birth trauma.
abstract_ja: 胎児は分娩時に機械的な力を受けるため、外傷を負うことがある。出生外傷には、頭蓋内出血、脊髄病変、頭血腫、頭蓋または末梢神経麻痺、腹腔内臓器破裂、骨折などが含まれる。初産婦、多胎、異常分娩位、母児間の不均衡、羊水過少、鉗子・吸引分娩、内回転術などは、出生外傷と周産期死亡のリスクを高める。極低出生体重児（1500g未満）は頭蓋変形を起こしやすくリスクが高い。特に出生前診断がない場合、正常な解剖を歪める特定の先天異常や病態を持つ乳児も高リスクとなる。本稿では、正期産の新生児が頸椎（C5-7）の脱臼骨折により、脊髄が亜全離断し麻痺を負った症例を報告する。胎児は頭位であり、徒手経腟分娩が試みられた。頭部と上肢の困難な娩出後に児が産道で嵌頓し、腹部が腫大していることが触知されたため、緊急帝王切開に切り替えられた。児は3日間生存した後、試みた経腟分娩中に受けた外傷による神経学的合併症で死亡した。剖検で、未診断の腹腔内未熟奇形腫が判明した。新生児に最も多い腫瘍であり、時に出生外傷の原因ともなる奇形腫の病理を検討し、出生外傷に関する文献をレビューする。
